sections.title: Confidant Abilities
head: Rank
Ability
rows:
Slack Off:
Allows you to perform various activities (read, craft, or sleep) in Kawakami's class.

Housekeeping:
Allows you to request Kawakami to make coffee or do laundry for you.

Free Time:
Allows you to Slack Off in other teachers' classes.

Super Housekeeping:
Allows you to request Kawakami to make curry or infiltration tools for you.

Special Massage:
Allows you to request a massage after going into the Metaverse, letting you go out at night.
